intro: Rites of the Earthmother marks the beginning of an initiate's spiritual journey on Red Cloud Mesa. Directed by Chief Hawkwind, travelers seek out Seer Graytongue in the southern hills of Camp Narache. Undertaking these venerable ceremonies is considered a vital trial of passage for tauren coming of age.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your willingness to perform a humble task for the traveler of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, friend. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as an adventurer of greatness.
Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.
The first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.
You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
